anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex curvature with a smooth, large-radius arc extending from the dorsal crest to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stout horizontal protrusion with a blunt terminal tip and high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Identifiable obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope transitions into the horizontal rostrum line.
